propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge on GitHub (read-only mirror); their diffs must be re-landed as three independent Gerrit changes and PRs closed by hand.

Click 8.2.1 transitive dependency has PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection vulnerability) blocking all CI verification runs; requires lock bump to >=8.3.3 before either dependabot PR can pass the gating pip-audit scan.

PR #123 updates actions/setup-python from v6 to v7 (new SHA 5fda3b95) across 13 workflow files and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish to new SHA dc376773; requires updating two echo allowlist lines with the new pinned-action SHAs.

PR #124 bumps mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1; mcp 2.0 removes FastMCP, auth.settings, auth.provider, and transport_security APIs (v1 paths) that rebar-mcp imports, causing structural breakage.

The mcp>=1.28.1,<2 constraint outside pyproject.toml appears in .github/workflows/_optionality.yml and docs/adr/0050-mcp-optional-auth-resource-server.md; must be updated to <3 if mcp 2.0 proceeds or retained if deferred.

All three Gerrit changes must apply PR diffs verbatim (byte-identical SHAs via git apply) and either path 1 (full mcp 2.0 with passing test suite) or path 2 (ruff only, mcp <2 kept, mcp 2.0 deferred to follow-up ticket) is valid based on test evidence.
